Privacy Policy
 
 
 1. General Information
 
 The protection of your personal data is of utmost importance. This privacy policy informs you about how this application ("the App") handles your data.
 
 
 2. No Data Transmission
 
 · Local storage only: The App processes and stores all data exclusively on your local device.
 · No server connectivity: The app does not connect to the internet, does not use external cloud services, and does not transmit any information to the developer or any third parties.
 · No analytics or tracking: The App do not use any tracking tools, analytics software, or advertising identifiers to monitor your behavior.
 
 
 3. Device Permissions
 
 The App only requests technical permissions from your operating system that are strictly necessary for its local functionality (e.g. local storage access, call screening).
 
 
 4. Data Deletion
 
 Since all data is stored locally on your device, you have full control over it. You can delete all processed data at any time by clearing the App's cache and data or by uninstalling the App completely.

To perform its function, the app requires certain permissions. These permissions are divided into two categories: application permissions and runtime permissions.
 Application permissions are granted upon installation and cannot be revoked.
 Runtime permissions, on the other hand, are requested only when a feature requiring them is used. Users can revoke or re-grant these permissions at any time via the app's system settings.
 Please note that some app features may not function if these permissions are revoked.
 Additionally, this app requires the role of a call screening service to enable call filtering.
